### Wen suchen wir?
Für unser HR\-Team suchen wir per **1\. Dezember 2026** oder **nach Vereinbarung** eine flexible, motivierte und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit hoher Zuverlässigkeit.
Du bist belastbar und arbeitest präzise, pragmatisch sowie selbstständig und strukturiert. Deine IT\-Affinität, Deine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und Deine Begeisterungsfähigkeit zeichnen Dich ebenso aus, wie Deine lösungsorientierte Denkweise und Deine Freude an der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung von HR\-Prozessen.
Es gelingt Dir, Menschen für unser Unternehmen zu gewinnen. Mit Empathie und Fingerspitzengefühl begegnest Du Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten sowie Führungskräften auf Augenhöhe. Verbindlichkeit, Diskretion und Loyalität sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
Als Teil unseres HR\-Teams in der Deutschschweiz bist Du eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitende in sämtlichen personalrelevanten Belangen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der HR\-Leitung stellst Du die Umsetzung der HR\-Strategie sowie die Einhaltung arbeitsrechtlicher und regulatorischer Vorgaben sicher.
Du berätst und begleitest die Linie sowie die Mitarbeitenden entlang des gesamten Employee Life Cycle – von der Anstellung bis zum Austritt – und unterstützt kompetent in allen HR\-Themen, einschliesslich arbeitsrechtlicher Fragestellungen.
### Was sind Deine Hauptaufgaben?
* Beratung und Betreuung von Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden entlang des gesamten Employee Life Cycle (von der Anstellung bis zum Austritt) inklusive arbeitsrechtlicher Themen
* Sparringpartner für Führungskräfte in Führungs\-, Team\- und Performancefragen
* Operative Mitarbeit im HR\-Tagesgeschäft (Rekrutierung, Onboarding, Mutationen, Zeiterfassung, Ein\- und Austritte inkl. Temporäranstellungen)
* Mitwirkung in Change\- und Organisationsentwicklungsprojekten
* Planung und Koordination von Personalentwicklungs\- und Weiterbildungsmassnahmen
* Sicherstellung einer korrekten und termingerechten Payroll\- und Sozialversicherungsverarbeitung
* Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung von HR\-Prozessen, Richtlinien und Instrumenten
* Analyse von HR\-Kennzahlen sowie Ableitung geeigneter Massnahmen
* Engagement im Gesundheitsmanagement und bei Initiativen zur Förderung von Engagement und Unternehmenskultur
### Was bieten wir?
Bei uns erwartet Dich eine anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit in einem spannenden, innovativen und dynamischen Umfeld. Du wirst Teil eines engagierten, mitarbeiterorientierten HR\-Teams und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Gewinnung und Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden.
In unserem KMU\-Umfeld gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Ancotech AG aktiv mit und bringst Dich in eine leistungs\- und mitarbeiterorientierte Unternehmenskultur ein. Eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung rundet unser Angebot ab.
### Was bringst Du mit?

Wildlife's People Team is looking for a Senior HRBP to partner with senior leaders and build the people strategies that fuel performance, engagement, and growth. This is a strategic, hands-on role for an experienced HR generalist who has already earned trust in the room with senior stakeholders, who backs recommendations with data, and who thrives on structuring initiatives in a fast-moving, ever-changing environment.
You'll act as a trusted advisor across the business, coach managers through complex people moments, and drive HR initiatives end-to-end in close partnership with Talent Acquisition, Talent Development, Compensation & Benefits, People Operations, and Payroll.

Business Partnership & People Strategy
Build strong, trust-based relationships with business leaders, including senior and executive stakeholders, to understand team dynamics and co-create people strategies that drive performance and engagement.
Act as a trusted advisor on talent development, performance management, organizational design, and team effectiveness, ensuring HR solutions align with business goals and the employee experience.
Lead and land HR initiatives end-to-end, from framing the problem to implementation, in collaboration with Talent Acquisition, Talent Development, Compensation & Benefits, People Operations, and Payroll.
Coach and influence leaders, including those you have no direct authority over, to adopt new practices and navigate difficult people situations with confidence.
Champion adaptability and resilience, helping the organization navigate change, restructuring, and rapid growth without losing momentum.
Data & People Insights
Use HR data and metrics (attrition, engagement, performance, headcount) to identify trends, validate hypotheses, and inform workforce decisions.
Build and maintain reports and dashboards that give leadership a clear, structured read on people trends.
Translate data into a clear narrative and recommendation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Proactively flag workforce risks by spotting patterns early, before they become business problems.
What You'll Need
Must-have
Experience as a HR generalist / HRBP, with solid exposure to at least three of: talent development, performance management, organizational design, culture, compensation, people operations, or talent acquisition.
Proven senior stakeholder management: a track record of building credibility with, and influencing, executives, founders, or leaders you don't have formal authority over, including in difficult or skeptical relationships.
Data-driven mindset: comfortable using HR metrics and reporting (Excel required; SQL, Tableau, or Power BI a plus) to shape and defend recommendations, not just present them.
Structured, direct, and transparent communication style, able to synthesize a complex situation into a clear recommendation for senior audiences, in both English and Portuguese.
Demonstrated ability to structure and execute initiatives from scratch (0-to-1), and to see them through to completion, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth, or frequently-changing environment.
Resilience and sound judgment under ambiguity: knows which battles to pick, stays composed with difficult stakeholders, and adapts quickly when priorities shift.
Fluent in English and Portuguese (mandatory).

Experience as an HRBP in a scale-up, tech, or startup environment.
Exposure to multi-country or cross-border HR practices (labor law, compensation, or performance processes).
Genuine enthusiasm for the gaming industry.

Atuar na revisão contínua da estrutura da área, avaliando as necessidades dos clientes e as capacidades das pessoas, visando o melhor aproveitamento do time.
Utilizar dados e insights para apoiar uma tomada de decisão mais embasada, além de influenciar a melhoria contínua da qualidade e relevância dos dados coletados.
Diagnosticar e propor ações de engajamento, desenvolvimento e retenção de talentos, com base em dados e indicadores de RH.
Conduzir análises de riscos e oportunidades organizacionais, priorizando ações sustentáveis e alinhadas à cultura da empresa.
Apoiar na resolução de casos complexos com impacto estratégico, promovendo ambientes de trabalho saudáveis.
Monitorar processos de handover, mudanças de time e calibração de performance, garantindo consistência e mitigação de riscos.
Fomentar e facilitar ações de fortalecimento da cultura organizacional, alinhando valores e práticas entre equipes e lideranças.
Contribuir para programas de sucessão, reconhecimento, capacitação, mentoria e feedback.
Garantir a conformidade das práticas de gestão de pessoas com políticas internas e legislações aplicáveis.
Apoiar iniciativas de inclusão, diversidade, saúde mental e recrutamento em parceria com áreas especialistas.
Construir e manter relacionamentos de confiança com stakeholders internos, facilitando diálogos e workshops estratégicos.
Requisitos e qualificações

s.t:

Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Estratégica de Pessoas, Desenvolvimento Organizacional ou áreas afins;
Experiência prévia como HRBP ou em áreas de desenvolvimento organizacional;
Vivência com ferramentas de people analytics e gestão por indicadores.

The VP, Global People Operations is a strategic, forward-looking leader responsible for the design, delivery, and continuous evolution of AvePoint’s global People Operations function and our global office and workplace environments.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer and serving as a member of the Global People Leadership Team, this leader will shape an end-to-end employee experience that is consistent, scalable, and distinctly “One AvePoint” – from the moment a candidate accepts an offer through every milestone of their career with us, and across every office where our people gather.
This is an AI-forward role.

We are looking for a leader who will reimagine how People Operations and workplace services are delivered – moving us from process administration to a digitally enabled, automation-first operating model that meaningfully reduces manual work, accelerates cycle times, and frees our people partners and managers to focus on higher-value work.

The Head of People Operations will serve as the business owner for the continued evolution of MyHR, our HR technology platform, and will partner closely with RevOps, People Analytics, HRIS, IT, Finance, Legal and the broader People team to drive a unified global roadmap.

Global People Operations Leadership
Lead the global People Operations function, including HR operations, HR services, employee lifecycle administration, compliance, employee data, HR policy, and global payroll partnership.
Define and execute a multi-year People Operations strategy aligned to AvePoint’s growth, public-company requirements, and global expansion priorities.
Set the standard for service quality, response times, accuracy, and employee experience across all regions.
AI-Forward Process & Technology Optimization
Drive a step-change reduction in manual work across all aspects of People Operations through automation, AI agents, self-service, and intelligent workflows.
Identify and prioritize the highest-impact use cases for AI and automation across the employee lifecycle – onboarding, offboarding, data changes, letters and verifications, ticketing, knowledge management, policy Q&A, and global payroll preparation and reconciliation.
Partner with IT, HRIS, RevOps and Finance to integrate People Operations workflows with adjacent systems (Finance/ERP, Greenhouse, position management, commissions) to eliminate hand-offs and duplicate data entry.
Establish clear metrics, dashboards, and ROI tracking for automation and process improvement initiatives.
MyHR Business Ownership
Serve as the business owner for the continued evolution of MyHR, partnering with the HRIS team and developers to define the product roadmap, prioritize releases, and ensure adoption.
Translate business needs from across the Global People Team, employees, and managers into a clear, prioritized backlog that improves usability, scalability, and decision support.
Champion data quality, governance, and reporting standards within MyHR so it remains a trusted single source of truth.
Global Payroll
Own the global payroll operating model in partnership with Finance, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, controls, and compliance across all entities and EOR partnerships.
Drive standardization, automation, and vendor optimization across payroll providers; reduce manual reconciliation and close cycles.
Strengthen SOX controls and audit readiness for payroll and people data as a public company.
Office Management & Workplace Experience
Lead global office management and workplace operations across our office footprint, ensuring safe, productive, and welcoming environments that reflect our culture.
Partner with regional leaders, the CFO and the COO on real estate strategy, lease decisions, office expansions/consolidations, and workstation planning aligned to workforce planning and recruiting priorities.
Define and deliver a consistent in-office experience – from facilities and vendor management to events, hospitality, and hybrid work norms – that strengthens engagement and collaboration.
Employee Experience, Policy & Compliance
Own the global People policy framework, ensuring policies are clear, current, locally compliant, and aligned to AvePoint values.
Partner with Legal, HRBPs, and regional leaders to ensure compliance with employment laws and regulatory requirements across all jurisdictions.
Continuously improve manager and employee touchpoints – Day 1, life events, internal mobility, leaves, and offboarding – so each is simple, dignified, and on-brand.
Leadership & Cross-Regional Alignment
As a member of the Global People Leadership Team, contribute to enterprise-wide people strategy, organizational design, and cultural initiatives.
Build, develop, and lead a globally distributed team of People Operations, payroll, and office management professionals; model a culture of accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
Champion “One AvePoint” by sharing best practices across regions and ensuring consistent execution while respecting local nuance.

12+ years of progressive experience in People Operations, HR Operations, or HR Shared Services, including significant leadership experience in a global, multi-entity environment; public-company experience preferred.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale process and technology transformation in HR, including hands-on experience deploying automation, AI, and self-service capabilities at scale.
Strong business ownership experience with an HRIS platform (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle, or comparable); experience as the business product owner driving roadmap and adoption is highly preferred.
Deep knowledge of global payroll operations, controls, and vendor management; familiarity with EOR models and multi-country payroll providers.
Experience leading office/workplace operations or facilities at a multi-site global organization is a strong plus.
Strong working knowledge of employment law, compliance, and HR policy across multiple regions (NA, EMEA, APAC).
Excellent analytical, project management, and change management skills, with a track record of using data to drive decisions and demonstrate ROI.
Outstanding communicator and collaborator who builds trust quickly across functions, regions, and levels – including with senior executives, regional leaders, and front-line employees.
A builder’s mindset: pragmatic, hands-on, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by continuous improvement.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., SHRM-SCP, SPHR, GPHR) preferred.

Career progression and internal mobility opportunities across our global footprint in North America, EMEA, and APAC
Unlimited PTO
